snippet.title: [DVDrip] Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 2 - Japanese Official Trailer PV (HQ)
snippet.description:
ドラゴンボールZ Sparking! NEO PV

The last discovery I've made is a promo DVD that contains one of the trailers for Dragon Ball Z Budokai Tenkaichi 2. There are many different trailers for this game, but at least, we can get to watch this one in a good quality for an over 10 years old contains ! :)

Enjoy !
